title: laboratory.correction.v1
description: An append-only correction to a laboratory.result.v1. A correction never overwrites the original measured record — it references it and carries the corrected value, the actor who made it, and a reason. Full history is retained so 'what was measured, when, and who changed it' is always answerable.

result_id.description: The original result this correction references (never mutated).

corrected_value.description: The corrected concentration (in the result's unit unless unit is given).

unit.description: Unit of corrected_value if it differs from the original result's unit.

actor.description: Who made the correction — a user/operator reference, audited.

reason.description: Why the value was corrected (transcription error, re-assay, etc.).

provenance.description: An annotation on the observed record, never a mutation of it.
